thread:
Alex K: heads-up — opened a PR to change how we wire ExternalSecrets to consumer pods. instead of mounting vault creds on the node, the plan is to create per-service ExternalSecret serviceAccounts and use token projection + k8s auth to Vault so rotation is automatic and scoped. preview of changes below. pls skim for obvious breakages :eyes:

Maya P: nice. will this require terraform changes + a rollout window?

Alex K: yes terraform will add SA + RoleBinding + annotation on the ES controller namespace. also a small helm values tweak to set `consumerServiceAccount` on ES objects. example manifest patch: ```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payments-db-creds
spec:
  refreshInterval: 5m
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-backend
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: payments-db
  template:
    type: Opaque
  consumerServiceAccount: payments-svc-sa
```

Riley T: quick q — do we need projected tokens enabled on the consumer pods? some older workloads still use the legacy automount.

Alex K: yes projected token must be enabled. default token automount false + add projected volume. we add a small init/container patch in the sidecar injector (helm chart) to ensure projection for pods using `consumerServiceAccount` annotation.

Jamie S: security check — how are you limiting the Vault role? I want to make sure the SA -> k8s auth role only allows read to the path(s) for that ES.

Alex K: good call. plan is one Vault role per `namespace:service` pair and policy scoped to `secret/data/{{namespace}}/{{name}}/*` so rotated secrets are constrained. terraform snippet from plan: ```diff
+ resource "kubernetes_service_account" "payments" {
+   metadata { name = "payments-svc-sa" namespace = "payments" }
+ }
+ resource "vault_kubernetes_auth_backend_role" "payments_es" {
+   role_name = "payments-payments-svc-sa"
+   bound_service_account_names = ["payments-svc-sa"]
+   bound_service_account_namespaces = ["payments"]
+   policies = ["payments-es-read"]
+ }
```

Maya P: for rollout, ops should apply Terraform during low-traffic window. we should also have a fallback plan to revert to current secret mounting if anything goes wrong. can we do a canary in staging first?

Alex K: yes staging canary first. I've added a k8s Job that creates a test ExternalSecret + SA and asserts rotation happens within 6m. job is in the PR.

Riley T: consumers that don't opt in yet — will they keep working?

Alex K: unchanged consumers continue to use the existing mounted secrets until we annotate them. this is opt-in per-ES. no forced migration.

Jamie S: also add an audit log for role creation in TF plan — need to ensure we record which service requested the role. add tags/metadata in vault (we can use `display_name` on the role resource).

Alex K: done in the branch, added `tags = { owner = "payments" reason = "externalsecret-impersonation" }`.

Maya P: can you mark the PR with the list of teams/owners to notify? ops + security + dev-ex?

Alex K: yep added reviewers: @Maya P, @Jamie S, @Riley T, @platform-oncall. also added upgrade notes in the helm values doc.
